_comment: Counterfactual fork at the boss-floor reward screens, same checkpoint and same argmax policy.
The fight is already over at the fork state in every row: the boss is dead and player_won is the
engine's LAST-COMBAT flag (RunEngine.cs:1282 -> State.LastPlayerWon), not a verdict on the run.
What varies is only which item the policy claims first on the reward screen.
Card-screen fork (fork_phase=card_reward) is the negative control: all four actions agree per seed.
Relic-screen fork (fork_phase=relic_reward) is the deciding state on the truncating seed: 2 of 4
legal actions end the run as a win, 2 fall back to Map where the action mask empties.
Both screens advertise the same four bases. v2_flat_env._action_names only names base 3 ('proceed');
on the relic screen the other three are the still-pending reward items in engine order, on the card
screen they are the offered cards. The fork conclusion needs neither naming, only that the state is held
fixed and every legal action is replayed.

code_refs.other_exit_is_floor_arithmetic: RunEngine.cs:1983-1997 (AdvanceAfterNode: Floor >= terminalFloor, 17 for overgrowth / MapBossRow*2+1 = 33 for underdocks)
code_refs.reward_order_selects_the_exit: RunEngine.cs:1746-1781 (after the card: pending rewards -> RelicReward, none -> AdvanceAfterNode)

established: an act-2 truncation previously read as 'the policy reached the boss and could not finish' is a reward-screen-order artifact: on seed 130012038 the same policy, same seed and same already-won boss fight reaches phase=complete when it claims reward item 2 or proceeds instead of claiming item 0
the card-reward screen is not the deciding state -- substituting every legal action there leaves each seed's outcome unchanged

generated act-2 maps really do end at row 17: the run that exits to Map at floor 17 has no legal map action, so the floor-33 terminalFloor that AdvanceAfterNode uses for underdocks is unreachable for a generated act-2 run
act 1 is structurally immune to this path: its terminalFloor is 17, so both exits from the boss node end the run, which is why the Act-1 0/83 conversion deficit cannot be explained by it
not_established: which item index the boss relic occupies on the screen -- the pending set is ordered gold, potion, relic, card (RunRewardGenerator.cs:724-772) but per-seed composition was not decoded
how often reward-screen order flips an act-2 boss win in the population: this is 1 known case out of 79 act-2 arrivals, measured by replay rather than by sampling
scope: simulator_act1 label, generated act 2 (underdocks), argmax, one checkpoint
